description: Links as the tracker packed them with link 4 (the timeline in bits, the settings packed), recorded by the packLink of v2.67.0 (commit 5b130fae), the last release before the Door Randomizer's settings joined the settings table after its own, each beside the save it was made from: settings v2.67.0 added to that table (Ganonhunt, Completionist, the swords, the enemies' health, a No Logic run's glitches, a Mystery run's hidden glitches and entrances, shuffled bosses with keys in their dungeons). They stand for links already shared: never change their content or regenerate them (Biome only orders their keys).
